evidence.report: Compared all 24 matched revision 001 frames with the same 24 references. This candidate shortens and curls the coat panels to expose the early footwork, joins the shoulder silhouette, removes the raised shirt-disc shape, and adds a plain dark back-of-head proxy. It adjusts late arm reaches, knee bending, the final crossed-arm pose and dropped-pistol locations. Camera changes address the opening tower edge, compressed muzzle close-up, and orbit framing; projectile heights and haze are revised. Remaining limitations include coarse proxy anatomy and cloth, approximate smoke and air wakes, and inferred motion between samples. The complete replacement has not been rendered locally.
